title: ComBeautify: Leveraging Code Change Summaries for Conventional Commit Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern software development relies on version control systems such as Git to track changes and facilitate collaboration. While commit messages are crucial for conveying developer intent, they do not affect program functionality; as a result, developers often lack motivation to write meaningful ones. The Conventional Commits Specification (CCS) addresses this with a structured format and guidelines that help developers express the intent of a change, improving clarity and enabling automation. Yet, developers frequently struggle to express intent while adhering to the format. In particular, they may misclassify commits due to the large number of possible categories or the lack of project-specific guidance. We introduce ComBeautify, an approach that automatically generates CCS-compliant commit messages. translated_title: ComBeautify：利用代码变更摘要生成规范化提交信息
translated_abstract: 现代软件开发依赖于诸如Git之类的版本控制系统来跟踪变更并促进协作。虽然提交信息对于传达开发者意图至关重要，但它们并不影响程序功能；因此，开发者往往缺乏撰写有意义提交信息的动力。规范化提交规范通过结构化格式和指导原则来解决这一问题，帮助开发者表达变更意图，提高清晰度并支持自动化。然而，开发者在遵循该格式的同时表达意图时常常面临困难。特别是，由于可选类别数量众多或缺乏项目特定的指导，他们可能会错误地分类提交。我们提出了ComBeautify，一种自动生成符合CCS规范提交信息的方法。我们的混合方法利用大语言模型（LLM）对Git差异进行保留上下文的摘要，以改进提交分类。
tldr: 本文提出ComBeautify，利用大语言模型对Git差异进行保留上下文的摘要，自动生成符合规范化提交规范（CCS）的提交信息，帮助开发者更准确地表达代码变更意图。
en_tdlr: ComBeautify leverages context-preserving summarization of Git diffs with large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate Conventional Commits Specification (CCS)-compliant commit messages, helping developers accurately express change intent.
